bio.text: A.J. McCampbell is a Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 71.
According to his legislative profile, he grew up in rural Greene County, graduated from Eutaw High School in 1971, and earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Alabama in 1976.

The profile says he began in law enforcement in 1975 with the City of Tuscaloosa, later worked as a juvenile probation officer and as an investigator for the district attorney's office, and began a career in insurance sales with State Farm in 1990.
